title: A second project runs one item end to end on the plugin's /sprint, and its retrospective findings are kb items
goal: A git project other than the kb installs the plugin, writes its backlog.json (a repositories map when it spans repositories, a docs map, its forge), files or imports its items, and one item is claimed, dispatched to a headless worker, landed and closed by the plugin's sprint skill with the operator present; the retrospective's findings about the tooling are filed as kb bugs or stories under this epic (titles naming the plugin sprint run), each with a repro from that run, and a report in kb/_self/reports records the run. This story is the epic's fitness test: the epic is not done while it is open.
notes: Planned 2026-10-10 in SP-ciqk6gt6. Premise: none claimed (the epic fitness test); both checks fail now (no item title holds the marker in parentheses, no report file). The old check backlog.py find plugin sprint run passed before the work only because this story own goal holds those words, so the check names the marker the findings titles will carry. Needs a second git project and the operator present: the run is the operator, the findings are filed after it. Closes by done on the report commit of TK-ew6dsm2l, no drop --why.
